GAP_m365_direct_path_confirmed_is_render.assessment: INFERRED: the client is NOT the final authorization authority (permission/identity/tenant/policy are main-decided), but the client IS the sole source of the human-confirmation predicate on the direct M365 path; a compromised or scripted trusted renderer frame can assert consent. Mitigated by sender-origin trust + RBAC + audit; not by an independent main-side consent proof.

gate_assessments.reason: Every invokable channel must be RBAC/auth-gated or explicitly allowlisted; composition root THROWS at boot otherwise (runtimeCore.ts:4105-4117; runtimeAuthz.ts:1311-1328); bridge re-checks auth+permission per call with actor resolved server-side (secureBridge.ts:149-157; enterprise/authzGate.ts:242+); typed AuthorizationError crosses as a closed denial-code set. Evidence is source-read plus named test pins; suites were not executed in this pass.

AI cannot be the authority: MODEL_SELF_AUTHORIZATION blocked in kernel; capability approvalRequired is derived and unweakenable; live-brain admission is ASK-only with re-derivation (RULE-001/003/007 pinned); workforce approvals bind decidedBy to the authenticated principal and fail closed on null; assistant needsApproval always true for side-effect steps; no autonomous decision creation (single IPC caller). Caveat recorded as a gap: on the direct M365 path the human-confirmation predicate (`confirmed`) is renderer-supplied and main does not independently prove the gesture; assistant stamps decidedBy='user' literal.

Deny-by-default at every layer (boot throw, bridge, RBAC resolver, kernel DENY/HOLD, capability NOT_FOUND, terminal 'unresolved'); interrupted sessions never rerun; crash-orphaned commands become HOLD; UNKNOWN -> durable hold, effect at most once; governed persist failure refuses execution.

User can cancel a live ExecuteEngine session (state-only, cooperative, no AbortSignal), disable/pause connectors per workspace, stop app runtimes, cancel assistant requests and package ops. No global emergency stop-all exists (serviceManager.stopAll has no IPC); an in-flight CST effect is not abortable by design.

No unified registry with TOOL_ID/RISK_LEVEL/REQUIRED_AUTHORITY/REQUIRED_CONFIRMATION/SIDE_EFFECT_CLASS/EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT/ROLLBACK_CAPABILITY. Present per action: id, mutates, scopes, consequence (uniform C3), reversibility, policyVersion, approval TTL, idempotency identity; all 29 M365 mutating actions are CST-governed (measured). Absent per action: risk level, rollback capability, evidence requirement, differentiated required authority (all writes = connectors:manage).

Single kernel verdict for every M365 write, data import and journal post; approval is action- and scope-specific (APPROVAL_SCOPE_VIOLATION pinned); stale approval/claim/proposal/state rejected with explicit TTLs; connector facts folded into one policy grant; network/token alone never authorizes. Caveats: policyVersion is a recorded label not an input; workforce policy set is unversioned (no per-decision policy provenance); send-path CST stores are process-lifetime (m365SendPorts in-memory) while action-path idempotency is durable (DurableIdempotencyStore, connectors/index.ts:419-420).

Honest state vocabularies exist and refuse to fabricate VERIFIED_SUCCESS (operatorConsole.ts, m365Outcome.ts), denial codes are typed and parity-tested, hold reasons have labels. But the requested canonical labels (REQUESTED/AUTHORIZED/EXECUTED/DECISION_REQUIRED/NOT_PERMITTED/STOPPED/DEGRADED/OFFLINE) do not exist in packages/shared (0 hits); there is no single shared action-state enum across surfaces; the two renderer state mappers have no dedicated tests; DecisionSetStatus lets a renderer mark a decision 'completed' without any execution; the named honesty tests (appTabContentHonesty, productOpsHonesty) are absent.

gaps: No unified consequential-action registry with the seven requested fields; authority is spread across channel RBAC, CST cohorts, capability catalog, workforce verdicts and store-scope declarations.

Direct M365 write path: `confirmed` (the C3 approval predicate) and `confirmedAt` are renderer-supplied; main cannot distinguish a human click from a scripted trusted frame (contracts.ts:470; connectors/index.ts:625,669).
Assistant plan approval records decidedBy='user' literal rather than the authenticated principal (assistantService.ts:656).
Decision Center: renderer may set ExecutiveDecision.status='completed' with no execution linkage; decision-from-recommendation history stamps actor 'system' on a human-initiated act.
No global emergency stop / kill-all execution path; ExecuteEngine.cancel is state-only and cooperative (no AbortSignal).
No per-action RISK_LEVEL, ROLLBACK_CAPABILITY, or EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT; only mail.send has a verification oracle; all other M365 writes are Profile A (VERIFIED structurally unreachable).
policyVersion is a label, not an enforcement input; workforce governance policy set is unversioned (no per-decision policy provenance).
BoundDecisionClaim/Approval are unsigned in-process objects (no issuer authentication) — integrity is representational only.
mail.send CST ports are in-memory (process-lifetime) — restart-durable single-use not claimed for send; governedAction path uses DurableIdempotencyStore.
Requested state-label vocabulary absent from shared types; renderer state mappers (operatorConsole.ts, m365Outcome.ts) lack dedicated tests; appTabContentHonesty/productOpsHonesty tests do not exist.
Tests were not executed in this pass (background revalidation running); all 'PASS' assessments are from source reading and test names, not measured runs.
